notes: All 12 views inspected. Camshaft demonstration assembly on a bolted base plate: a shaft with eight correctly phased egg-shaped cam lobes, two pedestal bearing blocks with caps, and a brass timing gear with cut teeth and a bolted hub. The lobes are genuine 3D cams, not discs, and the gear teeth are cut geometry. The shaft and gear are a SEPARATE `_rotor` node from the base and bearings, so a rotation clip can be authored. Presented on a base by design as a teaching cutaway, and the rotor is separable.
limitations: Stylised Cozy-kit palette rather than photoreal materials.
The bearing blocks are fused to the base plate.
Cam lobes are stylised rather than dimensioned to any real engine.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
